import bpy
from math import radians

COLL_NAME='Lacerda_Do_Zero'

# Rebuild only our generated model.
old=bpy.data.collections.get(COLL_NAME)
if old:
    for obj in list(old.objects):
        bpy.data.objects.remove(obj, do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.collections.remove(old)

coll=bpy.data.collections.new(COLL_NAME)
bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)

def mat(name, rgba, rough=.6, metallic=0.0):
    m=bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.diffuse_color=rgba
    m.roughness=rough
    m.metallic=metallic
    return m

ivory=mat('Lacerda_Ivory',(0.78,0.71,0.58,1),.78)
white=mat('Lacerda_Trim',(0.93,0.91,0.84,1),.68)
dark=mat('Lacerda_Dark',(0.07,0.08,0.09,1),.34)
glass=mat('Lacerda_Glass',(0.18,0.25,0.28,1),.22)
brown=mat('Lacerda_GroundClad',(0.28,0.23,0.18,1),.82)
stone=mat('Lacerda_Paving',(0.34,0.34,0.33,1),.92)
metal=mat('Lacerda_Metal',(0.16,0.16,0.16,1),.36,.25)

def move_to_coll(o):
    for c in list(o.users_collection):
        c.objects.unlink(o)
    coll.objects.link(o)
    return o

def cube(name,loc,dims,material=None,bevel=0.0):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1,location=loc)
    o=bpy.context.object; o.name=name; o.dimensions=dims
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False,rotation=False,scale=True)
    move_to_coll(o)
    if material: o.data.materials.append(material)
    if bevel>0:
        b=o.modifiers.new('Bevel','BEVEL'); b.width=bevel; b.segments=3
    return o

def front_window(name,x,z,w=2.15,h=2.55):
    y=-4.36
    cube(name+'_Glass',(x,y,z),(w,.11,h),glass,.01)
    # outer white frame
    t=.10
    cube(name+'_FrameL',(x-w/2,y-.08,z),(t,.12,h+.18),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_FrameR',(x+w/2,y-.08,z),(t,.12,h+.18),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_FrameT',(x,y-.08,z+h/2),(w+.18,.12,t),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_FrameB',(x,y-.08,z-h/2),(w+.18,.12,t),white,.01)
    # mullions: real facade has multi-pane windows
    cube(name+'_MullionV',(x,y-.10,z),(.08,.13,h),white,.005)
    for dz in (-h/4,0,h/4):
        cube(name+f'_MullionH_{dz:+.2f}',(x,y-.10,z+dz),(w,.13,.07),white,.005)

def side_window(name,y,z,w=1.95,h=2.45):
    x=7.56
    cube(name+'_Glass',(x,y,z),(.11,w,h),glass,.01)
    t=.10
    cube(name+'_FrameF',(x+.08,y-w/2,z),(.12,t,h+.16),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_FrameB',(x+.08,y+w/2,z),(.12,t,h+.16),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_FrameT',(x+.08,y,z+h/2),(.12,w+.16,t),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_FrameD',(x+.08,y,z-h/2),(.12,w+.16,t),white,.01)
    cube(name+'_MullionV',(x+.10,y,z),(.13,.07,h),white,.005)
    for dz in (-h/4,0,h/4):
        cube(name+f'_MullionH_{dz:+.2f}',(x+.10,y,z+dz),(.13,w,.07),white,.005)

# Praça / upper landing
cube('Praca_Base',(0,0,-.18),(46,32,.36),stone,.05)

# Ground floor, darker cladding under the wide canopy.
cube('Terreo_Corpo',(0,.15,2.05),(18.4,8.0,4.1),brown,.06)
cube('Marquise_Principal',(0,-3.95,4.25),(21.8,5.0,.34),ivory,.28)

# Five front bays beneath the canopy.
for i,x in enumerate((-7.2,-3.6,0,3.6,7.2),1):
    cube(f'Terreo_Vao_{i:02d}',(x,-4.02,2.05),(2.55,.16,3.2),dark,.02)
for i,x in enumerate((-5.4,-1.8,1.8,5.4),1):
    cube(f'Terreo_Pilar_{i:02d}',(x,-4.15,2.05),(.42,.42,3.8),brown,.02)

# Main upper station block: two rows x three bays on the FRONT.
cube('Bloco_Superior',(0,.15,9.05),(14.9,8.5,9.6),ivory,.08)
# Simple Art-Deco parapet and raised center.
cube('Parapeito_Topo',(0,.15,14.18),(14.9,8.5,.66),ivory,.04)
cube('Topo_Central',(0,-.10,14.72),(6.6,8.0,.70),ivory,.04)

# Three vertical front bays, exactly 6 front windows total.
for x in (-4.65,0,4.65):
    front_window(f'Janela_Frontal_Inferior_{x:+.2f}',x,7.45)
    front_window(f'Janela_Frontal_Superior_{x:+.2f}',x,11.20)
    # decorative panel between rows, visible in the real facade
    cube(f'Painel_Decorativo_{x:+.2f}',(x,-4.42,9.28),(2.35,.16,1.18),white,.03)

# Narrow vertical pilasters framing the three front bays.
for i,x in enumerate((-6.2,-2.33,2.33,6.2),1):
    cube(f'Pilastra_Frontal_{i:02d}',(x,-4.27,9.35),(.34,.28,7.7),white,.02)

# Right-side windows visible in oblique reference views (kept separate from the 6 FRONT windows).
for y in (-2.6,0.0,2.6):
    side_window(f'Janela_Lateral_Inferior_{y:+.2f}',y,7.45)
    side_window(f'Janela_Lateral_Superior_{y:+.2f}',y,11.20)

# LACERDA sign.
bpy.ops.object.text_add(location=(0,-4.43,13.45),rotation=(radians(90),0,0))
t=bpy.context.object; t.name='Texto_LACERDA'; t.data.body='LACERDA'; t.data.align_x='CENTER'; t.data.align_y='CENTER'; t.data.size=.82; t.data.extrude=.035; t.data.bevel_depth=.008
move_to_coll(t); t.data.materials.append(metal)

# Circular emblem above sign.
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(vertices=48,radius=.62,depth=.16,location=(0,-4.48,14.54),rotation=(radians(90),0,0))
em=bpy.context.object; em.name='Emblema_Circular'; move_to_coll(em); em.data.materials.append(metal)

# Scale reference, off to the side.
cube('Escala_2m',(12,-9,1),(0.10,.10,2.0),metal,0)

# Select and frame the generated building.
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for o in coll.objects:
    o.hide_set(False); o.hide_viewport=False; o.select_set(True)
main=bpy.data.objects.get('Bloco_Superior')
if main: bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=main
framed=0
for window in bpy.context.window_manager.windows:
    for area in window.screen.areas:
        if area.type!='VIEW_3D': continue
        region=next((r for r in area.regions if r.type=='WINDOW'),None)
        if region:
            with bpy.context.temp_override(window=window,screen=window.screen,area=area,region=region):
                bpy.ops.view3d.view_selected(use_all_regions=False)
            area.tag_redraw(); framed+=1

print(f'Rebuilt from real facade reference: FRONT_WINDOWS=6; SIDE_WINDOWS=6; OBJECTS={len(coll.objects)}; FRAMED={framed}')
